meta.title: Privacy · Typio
meta.description: What Typio stores about you, and what it never does.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: Here is, in plain words, what Typio keeps about you and why. The less we keep, the better.

stored.identity: Your username (your sign-in name), your display name and the date your account was created.
stored.password: Your password, only as an argon2id hash. It is never stored in plain text: nobody can read it back.
stored.preferences: Your language and your keyboard layout.
stored.session: Your session on the server: a fingerprint of your session token and its expiry date. The token itself is not stored.
stored.results: Your race results, once races are available.

cookies.session: A session cookie keeps you signed in. It only holds a random token: your status and your information stay on the server.
cookies.duration: With "Stay signed in", this cookie lasts 30 days. Without it, it is a session cookie, and the session expires after 24 hours at most, even if your browser restores it.
cookies.preferences: Your language is remembered in a cookie for one year, and your theme (light or dark) in your browser's storage.

privacy.guests: A guest is deleted, along with all their data, when they sign out, and at the latest during the automatic cleanup that follows the 24-hour expiry.

security.ip: Your IP address is used for 1 hour at most to block attacks. It only stays in memory until it is automatically cleared, and it is never saved in the database.

never.email: Typio never asks for an email address.
never.tracking: There are no ads and no tracking.
